title: Covariance Identification Geometry and Adaptive Confidence Sets in a Short Lagged-Exposure Panel
banked_reason: Delivered tier incremental below the field floor: the anchor-faithful white-disturbance restriction has only a fixed same-law lower bound, while a matching adaptive theorem requires a new transversality phase diagram.
gap_reasons: The rate relies on a deliberately chosen numerical box and unrestricted outcome-error covariance; under common white outcome disturbances, the note proves a same-law pair and its fixed diameter lower bound, but no adaptive rate theorem.
The restricted design and missing practical calibration keep the delivered package below the field floor and constrain its projected paper score.
D0.5.G projected paper-score gate: paper_score_ceiling 6.1 < 7.4, so the graded tier 'subfield' is capped at 'incremental'.
proof_attempt_summary: The run proved the exact nonlinear covariance fiber, an anchor-faithful white-disturbance subfiber with positive-definite Gaussian observational twins, and matching finite-sample confidence-diameter bounds on the declared unrestricted-Ω compact class. The field-tier package collapsed because the adaptive rate does not transfer to the published white-disturbance class: its additional equality generically identifies the measurement variance, while the twins lie on a degeneracy. A stronger result would require a new transversality coordinate, constrained local paths, and a matching weak-identification phase diagram rather than a scoped repair.
tldr: The structural coefficients in this three-exposure, two-outcome panel have the exact covariance fiber \(\mathcal F(\Sigma)\) from \((u,z,v)=((e+\delta)r,er,es)\) and a strict Schur-complement interval. At equal effects, a nonzero target has positive-definite Gaussian same-law twins even with white outcome disturbances; the zero target is identified. On the stated broader compact class with unrestricted positive-definite outcome-error covariance, finite-sample feasible-moment sets and Gaussian two-point lower bounds match the capped diameter rate \(R_n(r,s)=n^{-1/2}+|s|\min\{1,(\sqrt n|r|)^{-1}\}\).
gap: Existing panel EIV work supplies linear annihilators, GMM estimability, and local dynamic rank conditions; weak-identification work supplies asymptotically valid tests under nonlinear links and bounds. The inspected sources do not state the exact global fiber for this short panel or the finite-sample, target-dependent confidence-diameter theorem.
fill: Prove the necessary-and-sufficient covariance and Gaussian full-law fiber, exhibit strict-interior twins, and then establish matching finite-sample upper and Gaussian lower confidence-diameter bounds on exactly the same endpoint-rich compact class.
